final_profiles.purpose: Diagnostic attribution only; formal aggregate acceptance remains the separate three-repeat perf measurement.
final_profiles.category_boundary: Whole linked driver ELF including workload loop, runtime/startup and inlined library functions; shared objects are included in total Ir but excluded from driver categories.
final_profiles.load_category: Move from memory; stack operations and arithmetic with memory operands are separate.
final_profiles.call_edge_costs: Inclusive and overlapping; do not add to self costs.
offline_parser_repairs: Resolve inherited callee-object labels only when exact function has a unique owner; retain ambiguous labels.
Accumulate raw per-function instruction counts at exact ELF addresses to avoid overwritten aliased-address exports. Immutable raw traces and JSON retained.

final_graphs.method: One DUMP_GRAPH=1 diagnostic compile per captured library, no runtime or timing; complete S-input/S-final/L-final retained for three exact targets.

next_hypothesis.mechanism: S-level scalar snapshot/value Phi across loop backedges for typed borrowed mutable fields.
next_hypothesis.existing_limit: transforms/memory/forward.rs crosses effect Phis only when all inputs reach one unchanged memory version; it does not create value Phis from different reaching snapshots/stores.
final_graph_evidence: GraphemeCursor::prev_boundary retains p0:Unique(88), loop region n7, effect Phi n60 and field-0 LoadValue n61.
Parser::parse retains local mutable Parser state, calls to parse_unit with Unique(32), and typed iterator loads/stores after inlining.
required_proofs: Same typed place and valid observed/stored snapshot on every incoming edge; preserve predecessor order.
Keep initial and guarded reads at original points, and keep physical writes.
Invalidate at unknown writes, calls receiving root/derived pointers, reborrow/opaque/lifetime boundaries; use only explicit existing preservation contracts.
next_hypothesis.acceptance: Unchanged all13 instruction geomean, same LLVM MIR0 and counts, checksum/native gates and compile/text accounting; load-category counts alone do not establish alias safety.
